posts.text: I'm proud to endorse @AbdulElSayed for the US Senate. We must guarantee healthcare to all Americans. He will fight to get money out of politics, put money back in your pocket, and pass Medicare for All. Abdul can & will flip this seat. I’ll do all that I can to help him win.
posts.summary: Endorses Abdul El Sayed for Senate, advocates Medicare for All
